vocabulary.definition: competition for the same objective or for superiority in the same field
vocabulary.example: The rivalries between the two football teams are legendary.
She felt intense joy when she received the award.
The soup was quickly consumed by the hungry guests.

vocabulary.definition: a select group that is superior in terms of ability or qualities to the rest of a group or society
vocabulary.example: The elites of the society lived in luxurious mansions.

vocabulary.definition: currently in existence; not new or original
vocabulary.example: The company modified its existing policies to adapt to the changes.

vocabulary.definition: the action of deserting a person, cause, or organization
vocabulary.example: His desertion from the army led to severe consequences.
